title: Eavesdropping
text: “Hey, this feels just like a video game.”
“It does seem like a game, but it’s not—”
“This world is the world of console games.”
“No, it’s not. It’s a VRMMO.”
“Huh? VRMMO—as in Virtual Reality MMO? Isn’t that something from the future?”
“What the—!? What are you even talking about?”
“Hold on, hold on!”
I cut off my Father and the others and blurted out.
“What’s up, Motoyasu? You’ve been keeping your mouth shut except for your self-introduction, and now that you finally speak up, you’re trying to take charge?”

My Father is calling me by my first name in a friendly way. In the previous loop and the one before that, he kept a slight distance from “Motoyasu-kun” partway through, but now he’s just calling me “Motoyasu.” Seeing Father’s suspicious gaze, this Motoyasu here feels a wave of nostalgia wash over him. Based on my future experience, even if I told Father and the others the truth right now, it would still fall within the margin of error. In other words, at this point, it means Father doesn’t believe me either.
“Ren, Itsuki, and Father. I want you all to listen carefully.”
“W-what?”
“You just called me ‘Father’ as if it were the most natural thing in the world. What’s that about? Is this some kind of joke?”
Father replies with a hint of amusement. It’s a different reaction from the last two loops. This is probably his true nature. From the looks of it, he seems to enjoy going with the flow.
“I am your Father. This isn’t a joke or anything—I’m the man who’s going to be Motoyasu’s Father.”
“Huh?”
Leaving my Father standing there with a blank look on his face for a moment, I’ll explain.
“Everyone here comes from completely different worlds. Even within Japan, they’re totally different. Just keep that in mind.”
“I-is that so?”
“First off, Ren-kun comes from a Japan where VRMMOs exist. And Itsuki-kun was summoned from a Japan where psychic powers exist.”
“Huh?”

My Father is staring at me with half-closed eyes. He doesn’t seem to believe me. I suppose that’s understandable. Realistically speaking, it would be strange if VRMMOs or psychic powers actually existed. But based on our experiences so far, Ren and Itsuki will prove it all on their own.
“I was wondering what you were suddenly talking about… There’s no way someone from a sci-fi Japan with VRMMOs would go out of their way to come to another world, right? Stop talking nonsense—”
“Why are you stating the obvious? It happens all the time, doesn’t it?”
“Huh!?”
“Huh!?”
Rin’s words made my Father and Itsuki’s voices crack. Then they looked back and forth between me and Rin.
“No way, there’s no such thing!”
“Yeah, there isn’t.”
“Then… then what about psychic powers, Itsuki?”
“You mean supernatural abilities? There are people who possess those.”
“No way!”
“There aren’t!”

And so, they were repeating a conversation I’d seen before. They were discussing the fact that they’d come from a different Japan. Eventually, perhaps having calmed down a little, my Father and the others turned their attention to me.
“Motoyasu, how do you know all that?”
“Actually, I’ve been looping through this world.”
“Looping? You mean repeating the same time over and over, right? So, are you originally from this world?”
“No, I’m not. At first, I was stabbed by a pig and died in a parallel world’s Japan, and then I was summoned to this world.”
“A pig? You were summoned from a Japan where pigs are just a normal part of life… You’re something else.”
My father seems to have misunderstood something.
“In the future world, you asked me if I might have come from a galge world, didn’t you?”
“Huh… So that’s your backstory?”
“Unfortunately, since it’s my own world, I don’t really know.”
Seeing my father looking so amused made Motoyasu feel cheerful too.
“So, both Ren-kun and Itsuki-kun are under the mistaken impression that they’ve each come to the world of a game they know well.”
“Is that so? I did think this world looked a lot like a game I’d played extensively… Actually, I thought the same thing when Ren-san was explaining Status Magic.”
“Ah, this world is the world of Brave Star Online.”
“That’s a huge mistake. The enhancement methods you two know will eventually reach their limits.”
“Meaning?”
“The methods of strengthening that Ren and Itsuki each possess overlap.”
“Hmph.”
“Ah, that’s right.”

Judging by this reaction, it’s clear from the information about the future that they don’t believe me. Figuring out how to get these two to believe me will likely be my main challenge for the time being. We were discussing their ages and the characteristics of their respective worlds, but halfway through, both Ren and Itsuki started zoning out. The only one listening seriously is my Father.
“Ren and Itsuki say that, based on their gaming knowledge, tank classes are losers, but please don’t believe them, Father.”
“Are tank classes really losers?”
“That’s not the case at all.”
“Hmm… So there are all sorts of ways to level up, huh? Anyway, why is Motoyasu calling me ‘Father’?”
“Because you are my Father.”
“Huh? I don’t get it.”

My father, his eyebrows furrowed, is staring at me with an annoyed look. Did I say something rude? Ren and Itsuki shrug slightly, glance at each other, then look away. That’s a dangerous sign. Well… I suppose there’s nothing to be done—neither Ren nor Itsuki has ever successfully persuaded anyone at this stage before.
“You’re going to be the father of the girl I love most in the future, you know. That’s why I’m calling you ‘Father’ as a term of endearment.”
“Eh…? Even if that’s true, are you going to keep fighting in this world until you have a daughter? Are you looping through time in ten-year increments?”
Oh? It seems my Father has started to get the wrong idea. I guess I just didn’t explain it very well.
“That’s not it. Your daughter, Filo-tan… will probably be born in about a month or so.”
“No way!”
Father started laughing for some reason. What’s going on?
“Wait… hold on. This is another world. Maybe common sense doesn’t apply here…”
As expected of Father—his ability to pick up on things is second to none.
“So then. What’s my future wife like?”
“Father will go through some tough experiences that’ll make him hate women, and he’ll end up sleeping with men.”
“Huh!? Can you have a kid by sleeping with a man…?”
I’ve got to tip my hat to Motoyasu’s imagination—his thoughts really do leap to the most unexpected places.
“I’m sorry, but… that just made it completely unbelievable. Kitamura-kun, I’m sorry.”

And just like that, my father put some distance between us. His attitude toward me—which had been so friendly, even calling me “Motoyasu”—has taken a nosedive; now he’s back to addressing me by my last name with the honorific “-kun.” At this rate, I won’t be able to bring up the facts about the false accusation I’ve been hesitating to discuss.
“That’s not it! You, Father, ate a Filolial egg—”
“Hero, dinner is ready.”
I know the timing is bad… but it’s my mistake for forgetting it was coming. Oh well. I’ll just have to bring it up next time.
“Well then, once we’re done eating, I’ll give your Father a thorough lecture on how to enhance his abilities.”
“No, it’s fine. I got the gist of it…”
Your Father politely turned me down. That’s strange. Did I do something wrong? After exchanging a few words like that, we were led to the dining hall.

It reminds me of that first meal I had after arriving in this other world—my heart was racing with excitement. While the flavors are familiar to me now, it’s true that the seasoning is a bit different from modern Japan. With those thoughts in mind, we finished our meal and decided to turn in early.

However, I’m thinking about my usual routine… going to visit Filolial-sama at the castle. After making sure my Father and the others are fast asleep, I’ll get out of bed and walk through the castle. Once I receive my dowry, should I head straight to the monster merchant to buy Filolial-sama?

Hmm… A Filolial farmer would probably sell her to me for less than the monster merchant would… I must use my dowry wisely to raise my Father. Should I take a gamble and try to get Filo-tan…? It’s quite a dilemma. As I was thinking this and about to step out into the castle garden, I heard a voice.
“Around what time tomorrow will we be able to meet the Hero?”

As I walked toward the voice, the castle’s guest quarters came into view. Looking over, I saw they weren’t asleep yet… Racking my brain, I recalled that Ren’s future companions seemed to be having a brief discussion with some soldiers in the hallway. I suppose those Trashes are preparing to join his party. It’s not really something to worry about.
Just as I was thinking that and about to head toward the castle garden… that’s when I spotted him.
“Hey, this bed is way too hard! Don’t you have a better one?”

It was him—the one who joined my party for a few days before leaving to join Itsuki’s group… the mastermind who killed Itsuki and caused the last loop. “Smoked Meat” was standing there, bossing the servants around and ordering something.
